cashflow.comparison: same-report-period current versus prior year, signed amount comparison

profit.comparison: same-report-period current versus prior year, signed amount comparison

capital_spending.comparison: current greater than prior, nonnegative amount required

aggregation: Counts and proportions of common eligible nonfinancial issuer members; at least 5 and 80 percent coverage
meaning: Co-direction or divergence of two explicitly different accounting measures; not profit-to-cashflow reconciliation
negative_profit: valid signed comparison, not percentage growth
